# Waddle

Clown waddling is an upstream SS14 feature (#26338) that upstream later disabled (#32652). This module remakes it
to fix the issues it had, keeping upstream's step animation and taking the hotbar toggle, action and alert text from
Impstation. The wearer gets a "Toggle Waddling" hotbar action and a "Waddling" alert while it is on. Add
`WFBaseWaddleShoes` to a shoe prototype's parents to get it.
